hook: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file
hookText: NariQ: BF16-level Qwen3.8-27B in a 10 GB file

beats.say: NariQ packs a Qwen3 8-billion-parameter model at BF16-level quality into a 10 GB file using a new quantization approach.
Terminal-Bench 2.1 score over 82 tasks × 3 attempts, against file size. One BF16 verifier timeout in round 3 counts as zero.

Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-3.0bpw.gguf Qwen3.8-27B-NariQ-mmproj-BF16.gguf --local-dir. llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-N. Across the same three rounds, the mean share of each task's new tests that passed was 83.1%, 82.9%, 83.2% and 77.2%.
